title: Drift Wood #3 · the assembly
logline: Three hundred people, one direction, a man with a microphone and a plan for their futures.

panels.composition: The gym. Bleachers. Three hundred students facing one direction. A PRINCIPAL at a microphone under a banner: YOUR FUTURE STARTS NOW. WOOD, CHLOE and GULLY in the top row.

characters.pose: beside her, cap backwards, drawing on his knee

balloons.text: ...and every one of you has a future in this county.

image.prompt: a high school gym assembly from the top of the bleachers, hundreds of students facing a principal at a microphone under a banner, three teenagers in the top row: a boy in an overcoat, a girl reading, a boy in a backwards cap drawing on his knee

panels.composition: Wood, to Chloe, not lowering his voice enough.

characters.pose: not looking up from the book

balloons.text: He said county. Not world. Not state. He looked at three hundred people and said county.
He's the principal, Wood. He's also in the county.

image.prompt: close two-shot on a bleacher, a teenage boy leaning to whisper too loudly to a girl who keeps reading her paperback

panels.composition: Gully holds up his knee-drawing: the principal as a seagull with a microphone. Surprisingly good.

characters.pose: holding up a drawing on notebook paper

props: a drawing of a seagull at a microphone

image.prompt: a teenage boy in a backwards cap holding up a notebook-paper drawing of a seagull at a microphone, grinning, bleachers behind

panels.composition: Wood looking at the drawing. Then at Gully. Something adjusting.

characters.pose: looking at the drawing, then at Gully

image.prompt: a teenage boy in an overcoat looking with surprise at a drawing held by a boy in a backwards cap who is already drawing the next one, gym assembly below

notes: The first time Wood notices Gully can draw. The strip pretends it isn't a big deal.
